# New renderings, iliad-139 (22.90–187)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἐλεγχείην ἀναθήσει (22.100; ἐλεγχείη "reproach, disgrace") | "will lay disgrace upon me" | "will be the first to lay disgrace upon me" | "put the blame on me", "heap reproach", "shame me"; follows the table's ἐλέγχεα "disgraces" |
| ἐϋκλειῶς (22.110; ἐϋ- "well" + κλέος "fame") | "with fair fame" | "with fair renown" | "gloriously" (κῦδος words), "with good report", "honourably" |
| ὀμφαλόεσσαν (ἀσπίδα, 22.111) · βριαρήν (κόρυθα, 22.112) | "bossed" · "weighty" | "bossed" · "heavy" | "with a navel", "studded"; "stout"; follows the table’s βριαρήν row (iliad-067); ὀμφαλός "boss" |
| γερούσιον ὅρκον (22.119; γερούσιος "of the elders", cf. γερούσιον οἶνον 4.259) | "an elders’ oath" | "an elders’ oath" | "a council's oath", "a solemn oath" (kept for καρτερὸς ὅρκος) |
| ἀπὸ δρυὸς οὐδ’ ἀπὸ πέτρης (22.126; proverbial, sense not known) | "from oak or from rock" | "from an oak or from a rock" (+ note: exact sense not known) | "from tale and fable", "like a child with a nursery tale" (each decides the unknown) |
| ὀαρίζετον (ἅ τε … ὀαρίζετον, 22.127–128, dual) | "converse" (such talk as … converse) | "hold" (such talk as … hold with one another) | "whisper", "dally"; follows the table's ὀαρίζω "converse" / "talk with" |
| ὅρμαινε μένων (22.131; ὁρμαίνω "turn over in the mind") | "So he pondered, waiting," | "So he pondered, standing there," | "deliberated", "was divided"; ὁρμαίνω keeps the Odyssey's "ponder" |
| ἶσος Ἐνυαλίῳ κορυθάϊκι πτολεμιστῇ (22.132) | "equal to Enyalius, the helmet-shaking warrior" | "like Enyalius the helmet-shaking warrior" | "helmet-flashing" (κορυθαίολος is "of the glancing helmet"), "equal to Ares"; ἶσος "equal" in `l` as ἀτάλαντος "equal of" is kept for ἀτάλαντος; κορυθάϊξ from κόρυς + ἀΐσσω (formation uncertain, noted); πτολεμιστής "warrior" |
| σείων Πηλιάδα μελίην (22.133) | "shaking the Pelian ash-spear" | "shaking his terrible Pelian ash-spear" | "brandishing" (kept for ἀμπεπαλών); follows the table's Πηλιάδα μελίην (16.143) and σείω "shake" |
| ὕπαιθα φοβεῖται (22.141; ὕπαιθα "from beneath / aside") | "from beneath flees in fear" | "flees in fear from underneath him" (+ note: picture not certain) | "swerves", "slips away" (each decides the picture) |
| ὀξὺ λεληκώς (22.141; λάσκω "cry out") | "having screamed shrilly" | "screaming shrilly" | "shrieking", "yelping", "with a sharp cry" |
| σκοπιή · ἐρινεὸν ἠνεμόεντα (22.145) | "the lookout" · "the windy wild fig-tree" | same | "watch-tower", "peak" (σκοπιή is the table's "lookout"); ἠνεμόεις keeps "windy"; ἐρινεός keeps "wild fig-tree" (6.433) |
| τείχεος αἰὲν ὑπ’ ἐκ (22.146) | "ever from under the wall" | "always out from under the wall" (+ note: the picture is not certain) | "keeping beneath the wall", "away from the wall" (each decides the picture) |
| κρουνὼ … καλλιρρόω (22.147, duals) | "the two springs, fair-flowing" | "the two fair-flowing springs" | "fountains", "streams"; πηγαί "springs" in the next line |
| πλυνοὶ … λαΐνεοι (22.153–154) | "washing-places … of stone" | "washing-places … made of stone" | "washing-troughs", "basins"; keeps the Odyssey's πλυνοί "washing-places" (6.40, 6.86) |
| ἱερήϊον · βοείην (22.159) | "sacrificial animal" · "oxhide" | "sacrificial animal" · "oxhide" | "victim", "ox-hide shield"; ἱερήϊον "animal for sacrifice", βοείη "oxhide" as in the table's βοείας (11.843) |
| ἀέθλια … ποσσίν (22.160) | "contest-prizes for the feet of men" | "prizes in contests that men’s feet run for" | keeps the table's ἀέθλια "contest-prizes … prizes in contests" (9.124) |
| ἀεθλοφόροι (ἵπποι, 22.162) | "prize-bearing" | "prize-bearing" | "prize-winning" (not yet won; iliad-138 ships "prize-winning" for ἀεθλοφόρος ἵππος at 22.22, where the horse is a champion — **a standing inconsistency within Book 22, flagged for the reviewer**: this part keeps the 11.699 / 9.124 row "prize-bearing") |
| τέρματα (22.162) | "turning-posts" | "turning-posts" | "boundaries", "goals", "finishing-posts"; τέρμα "end, limit", here the posts rounded |
| ἄεθλον (μέγα … ἄεθλον, 22.163; the prize, not the contest) | "prize" | "prize" | "contest" (kept for the Odyssey table's ἄεθλος "contest"); ἀέθλια "contest-prizes" in the plural |
| τρίπος … γυνή … ἀνδρὸς κατατεθνηῶτος (22.164) | "a tripod or a woman, of a man who has died" | "a tripod or a woman, for a man who has died" | "a dead man's widow", "in honour of" (adds the funeral games, said in the note) |
| καρπαλίμοισι πόδεσσι (22.166) | "on quick feet" | "on quick feet" | "swift" (kept for ταχέες πόδες, 22.173); follows the table's ποσὶ καρπαλίμοισι (16.342) |
| τοῖσι δὲ μύθων ἦρχε πατὴρ ἀνδρῶν τε θεῶν τε (22.167) | the Odyssey's wording, ending in a colon | the Odyssey's wording, ending in a colon | departs from the Odyssey (1.28) only in the final mark: ";" there, ":" here because the speech follows at once |
| ἐν πόλει ἀκροτάτῃ (22.172) | "in the topmost city" | "in the city at its very top" (+ note: the high citadel) | "in the highest town", "on the citadel" (names the place the Greek leaves as a superlative) |
| ὀλοφύρεται ἦτορ (22.169) | "my heart grieves for" | "my heart grieves for" | "mourns", "pities"; follows the table's ὀλοφύρομαι "grieve for" (8.33) |
| ἠέ μιν ἐκ θανάτοιο σαώσομεν, ἦέ μιν ἤδη Πηλεΐδῃ Ἀχιλῆϊ δαμάσσομεν (22.175–176) | "whether from death we shall save him, or now to Achilles son of Peleus shall we subdue him" | "whether we shall save him from death, or whether we shall now let him be overcome by Achilles, son of Peleus" | "kill him by Achilles", "give him up to"; δαμάζω keeps "subdue" / "overcome" and the dative "to" (cf. ἄλοχοι … δαμεῖεν "subdued to others") |
| ἔρξον ὅπῃ δή τοι νόος ἔπλετο, μὴ δ’ ἔτ’ ἐρώει (22.185) | "Do it in the way your mind has come to be, and no longer hold back." | "Do as your mind is set, and hang back no longer." | "do what you will", "as your heart wishes"; ἐρωέω keeps the table's "hold back" / "hang back" (2.179) |
| ἧφι βίηφι πιθήσας (22.107) | "obeying his own might" | "trusting in his own might" | "relying on his own strength" (κράτος is "strength"); πείθομαι "obey" in `l`, the sense in `i`; βίη keeps "might" |
| γυμνὸν ἐόντα (22.124) | "being naked" | "defenceless" (+ note: naked means unarmed) | follows the table's γυμνὸς ἐών (17.711) "without his armour" |
| καπνός (22.149; of the steam from the hot spring) | "smoke" | "smoke" | "steam", "vapour" (the note says it is steam) |
| Reused unchanged (no new row) | | | πελώριον "huge" (3.166); ἀμύμων "blameless"; ῥίμφα "nimbly"; λαιψηρά "quick"; ταρφέα "often" / "again and again"; τρόμος "trembling took hold"; ἀνώγει "bids"; μώνυχες ἵπποι "solid-hoofed horses"; κίρκος "falcon", ἐλαφρότατος πετεηνῶν "the lightest of winged things", τρήρων "timorous" (Odyssey); ἱπποδάμοιο "tamer of horses"; κραιπνοῖσι ποσί "rushing feet" (6.505); ἀργικέραυνε "of the bright thunderbolt" (19.121); κελαινεφές "dark-clouded"; the formula lines 22.98, 22.103, 22.105, 22.122, 22.156, 22.177, 22.179–181, 22.182, 22.183–184, 22.186–187 take the shipped English (with quotation marks added or the final stop adjusted to this context) |
| ἔτλη (22.136; τλάω) | "brought himself to" | per the table’s τλάω row (iliad-131 ships it so) | "dared" |
